text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"My heart was waiting.
Waiting for this very day."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Both the bitterness of losing,
and the frustration of not giving it my all."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Unleash it all, leave it all behind.
So today, I can run just being me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, yeah.
—I'm really, really looking forward to it.
